Management Plan

- Advice that presentation most likely viral upper respiratory tract/chest infection; expected self-resolution in 1–2 weeks.  
- Purchase thermometer and monitor temperature; seek review if ≥ 37.5 °C persistent, new/worsening symptoms (dyspnea, chest pain, purulent or bloody sputum/nasal bleeding).  
- Continue symptomatic relief with Lemsip but avoid additional paracetamol-containing products.  
- Limit cough syrup to nighttime use only if sleep is significantly impaired.  
- Reinforce need for regular diabetes and blood pressure reviews with primary GP.  
- No antibiotics prescribed today; consider if clinical deterioration.  
- Safety-net advice provided (call service again or seek in-person care if condition worsens).
